emptyBody: Remove a filter to see more.
sparkSummary: Running total at 1u per pick over {n} graded picks: {profit}.

tagMeaning.published_bet: Published pick you did bet; it is also in Apuestas, so it is left out of the Sombra figures.
tagMeaning.published: Published pick you did not bet.
tagMeaning.prop_near_value: Corners or cards total 0–3% over the consensus fair price.
tagMeaning.prop_value: Corners or cards total 3% or more over the consensus fair price, no model.
tagMeaning.near_value: Result or goals 0–3% over the fair price.
tagMeaning.value: Result or goals 3% or more over the fair price.
tagMeaning.model_only_shots: Shots pick backed by the model alone.
tagMeaning.shadow_rule30: Passed every filter, held in shadow by the rule 30 pause.
tagMeaning.shadow: Shadow pick for another reason (new market, short sample).
tagMeaning.low_edge: Passed the filters, but the stake fell under the 0.25u minimum.
tagMeaning.filter_reject: Rejected by a filter (gap, ratio, sample, razor, filter 4 or 5, rules…).
tagMeaning.bet: Real bet, with its stake and profit as the sheet records them.
tagMeaning.grok_not_priced: Grok pick we did not price.
tagMeaning.grok_other: Grok pick without a verdict yet.

d.missingBody: The sheet may have changed. Close this and look for it in the list.
d.clvHint: How much better your price was than the close, at the same source.
d.fairCloseEvHint: What your price is worth against the closing probability with the book's margin taken out.
d.booksCaption: Each book's price, its close and the other side
d.probBlendValue: For VALOR rows this column holds the consensus fair probability.
